assessments.reasoning: The NIST official legacy archive hosts the NBS publication. Its title and foreword identify the committee materials and their original approved release dates. The captured complete source exactly matches the registered digest ed60a71b77cb98a49267334b38fc334a7fcf4365dd593a8e467ac83ba363b780. The identified controlling passage is Part I (MDC/28), §1.2.5 Precedence of Operators, printed page 1-3 / PDF page 17. The MUMPS narrative specification in NBS Handbook 118 describes one precedence level for binary operators and gives unary operators precedence over binary operators. The claim addresses relative precedence. Grouping with parentheses and other syntax are separate. The delimiter listing identifies parentheses for grouping, which is compatible with the claim about operator precedence.
